title: The loop resubmits a finished head straight to its merge trial, with no host verification run
description: GY-3576: a worker blocked on a host fault names its finished head; after master unblock, with every host heavy-job slot held, one loop cycle submits that head through the production resubmit effect and the real engine. No heavy-job slot is taken, no action in master status names a worker verification, and the item goes on to review, proofs and its merge trial, which runs the tests and decides.

steps.name: one cycle after the unblock submits the finished head with every heavy-job slot held
